0.original: Fukata hopes you enjoy foul odors.

24.original: Sprinkle the bucket of smelly liquid at the designated locations.

48.original: Hello there, traveler. I require your help if you have the time. While I belong to the Doman Liberation Front, I am also a proud resident of Namai with my own responsibilities to the village.

49.original: I have been told to guard this spring and under no circumstances am I to leave my post. However, there is another job related to the village I need to take care of.

50.original: I was hoping you might do it in my stead. Here, take this liquid and sprinkle it around that area over there. You have my thanks!

51.original: Pray sprinkle that liquid around that area over there. You have my thanks!

53.original: No doubt you are wondering just why that liquid smells so foul. Well, it is made from a mix of pungent ingredients: animal innards, resin, and garlic to name but a few. It does a fantastic job of keeping the beasts at bay.

54.original: One of my fellow rebels taught me how to make it. Oh, and you will want to give your clothes, let us see...three <hex:021A020203>thorough<hex:021A020103> scrubbings ought to do it.
